description: Angular component for configuring REST API call settings within the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and dynamic validator updates.

classes.name: RestApiCallConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent for REST API call configuration.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for the REST API call configuration.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration values.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validator updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically updates validators based on form control values.
